selected_evidence.requirement: Consistent bidirectional file ownership and permissions

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 initial restart and corrective recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 7ec96d47-bbc7-442d-83fb-957b45cc0160 to 40ffae35-c270-4190-a183-b4bcc1e1235b. The mount required correcting the OpenRC service from nfsclient to nfsmount, after which mount and data health recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 persistence verification restart and recovery
